name: Confederate States of America (Stars and Bars, 11 stars, 1861)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red with a navy canton bearing a circle of eleven white five-pointed stars.
history: Version of the 'Stars and Bars' with eleven stars, one for each state that had actually seceded, used from 2 July 1861. On 28 November 1861 the Confederacy admitted the rival governments of Missouri and Kentucky and the final thirteen-star version followed on 10 December 1861.
